scope: Actual leading Gaussian/Rademacher inputs and two-count F4 comparison. New finite-prefix density upper and literal real-cutoff supports included. Optional duplication is explicitly partial supporting coverage.
status_policy: Supporting passage inference and statement acceptance are separate. Exact kernel types and routes are fresh hashed working-checkout exports, not a clean whole-paper replay. Lower author-owned source rows await separate independent review. Historical ledgers are preserved.

passages.title: Uniform Rademacher maximum, including r=1
passages.claim: The genuine independent-sign maximum has the printed uniform CDF error with original log(er) window; r=1 is supplied by scalar Berry--Esseen.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.familyRademacherMaximum_one_error
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (x : ℝ),
      |(RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familySignArrayLaw n 1).real
              {z | RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyRademacherMaximum z ≤ x} -
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.normalMaximumCDF 1 x| ≤
        RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerRademacherMaximumConstant *
          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.rademacherGlobalError n 1

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.eventually_lowerRademacherMaximum_global_error
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,
  ∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r),
    RectangleCLT.dimensionLog r ≤ RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.rademacherGlobalSmallConstant * √↑n →
      ∀ (x : ℝ),
        |(RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familySignArrayLaw n r).real
                {z | RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyRademacherMaximum z ≤ x} -
              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.normalMaximumCDF r x| ≤
          RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerRademacherMaximumConstant *
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.rademacherGlobalError n r

passages.title: Relative-tail and central ranges
passages.claim: Actual Rademacher relative moderate tails and scalar Berry--Esseen give the product-CDF error in the low and central ranges without a factor r.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.familyRademacherMaximum_central_error
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} [inst : NeZero m],
  1 ≤ n →
    2 ≤ m →
      ∀ {x : ℝ},
        0 ≤ x →
          x ≤ 2 * √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog m) →
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.moderateTailSmallConstant * (1 / √↑n * (1 + x)) ≤ 1 →
              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.rademacherRelativeTailError n x ≤ 1 →
                |(RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familySignArrayLaw n m).real
                        {z | RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyRademacherMaximum z ≤ x} -
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.normalMaximumCDF m x| ≤
                  32 * Real.exp 1 * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.moderateTailRemainderConstant / Real.exp (-1) *
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.rademacherGlobalError n m

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.familyRademacherMaximum_global_error_of_cutoff_conditions
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} [inst : NeZero m],
  1 ≤ n →
    2 ≤ m →
      RectangleCLT.scalarBerryEsseenConstant / √↑n ≤ 1 - RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.rademacherCDFCap →
        RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.moderateTailSmallConstant *
              (1 / √↑n * (1 + RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.rademacherCutoffAmplitude * √√↑n)) ≤
            1 →
          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.rademacherRelativeTailError n
                (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.rademacherCutoffAmplitude * √√↑n) ≤
              1 →
            RectangleCLT.dimensionLog m ≤ RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.rademacherGlobalSmallConstant * √↑n →
              ∀ (x : ℝ),
                |(RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familySignArrayLaw n m).real
                        {z | RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyRademacherMaximum z ≤ x} -
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.normalMaximumCDF m x| ≤
                  RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.rademacherGlobalConstant *
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.rademacherGlobalError n m

passages.title: Exact Gaussian maximum threshold
passages.claim: The actual quantile solving r*tail=1 has its true sqrt(2logr) asymptotic, and the actual maximum density divided by that scale tends to exp(-1).

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.printedNormalMaxThreshold_tail_identity
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {m : ℕ},
  2 ≤ m →
    ↑m *
        RectangleCLT.Companion.standardNormalUpperTail
          (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.printedNormalMaxThreshold m) =
      1

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.tendsto_printedNormalMaxThreshold_div_sqrt_two_log
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
Filter.Tendsto (fun p => RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.printedNormalMaxThreshold p / √(2 * Real.log ↑p))
  Filter.atTop (nhds 1)

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.tendsto_normalMaximumDensity_at_printed_threshold_div_sqrt_log
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
Filter.Tendsto
  (fun m =>
    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.normalMaximumDensity m
        (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.Printed.printedNormalMaxThreshold m) /
      √(2 * Real.log ↑m))
  Filter.atTop (nhds (Real.exp (-1)))

passages.title: Two-count exact maximum and independence
passages.claim: The actual r-by-m observation and Gaussian grid maxima separate into leading maxima and actual rare shifts; product law proves independence.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilySeparatedSum_maximum
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ (P : RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.SymmetricFamilyParameters) {n r m : ℕ} [inst : NeZero r] [inst_1 : NeZero m]
  (z : RectangleCLTArxivV1.LowerFamilySeparatedSeed n r m),
  (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.finiteMaximum fun ju =>
      RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilySeparatedSum P z (finProdFinEquiv ju)) =
    P.scale * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyRademacherMaximum z.1 +
      P.amplitude / √↑n * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyMaskedSignMaximum z.2

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilyGaussianPairMap_maximum
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ (P : RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.SymmetricFamilyParameters) {r m : ℕ} [inst : NeZero r] [inst_1 : NeZero m]
  (z : RectangleCLT.Vector r × RectangleCLT.Vector m),
  (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.finiteMaximum fun ju =>
      RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerGridGaussianMap P.scale (√P.variance) z (finProdFinEquiv ju)) =
    P.scale * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.finiteMaximum z.1 +
      √P.variance * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.finiteMaximum z.2

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilySeparatedSum_identDistrib
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ (P : RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.SymmetricFamilyParameters) (n r m : ℕ),
  ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilySeparatedSum P)
    (RectangleCLT.sumVector (RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilyNormalizedObservations P))
    (RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilySeparatedLaw P n r m) (RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilyArrayLaw P n r m)

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilyObservationShift_independent
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ (P : RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.SymmetricFamilyParameters) (n r m : ℕ) [inst : NeZero r] [inst_1 : NeZero m],
  ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (fun z => RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyRademacherMaximum z.1)
    (fun z => RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyObservationShift P z.2)
    (RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilySeparatedLaw P n r m)

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilyGaussianShift_independent
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ (P : RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.SymmetricFamilyParameters) (r m : ℕ) [inst : NeZero r] [inst_1 : NeZero m],
  ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (fun z => RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.finiteMaximum z.1)

    (RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerFamilyGaussianPairLaw r m)

passages.title: Actual all-active coverage for real cutoffs
passages.claim: The genuine column product law gives the natural-cutoff failure probability. Integer-valued counts and monotone real powers give the literal bound for every real b≥0.

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyMaskedSignMaximum_all_active_bound
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ (P : RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.SymmetricFamilyParameters) (n m : ℕ) [inst : NeZero m] (b : ℕ),
  (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyRestArrayLaw P n m).real
      {z |
        RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyMaskedSignMaximum z ≠
          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyActivationCount z} ≤
    (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyRestArrayLaw P n m).real
        {z | ↑b < RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyActivationCount z} +
      Real.exp (-↑m * (P.pi / 2) ^ b)

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.familyActivationCount_real_cutoff_event
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ {n m : ℕ} {b : ℝ},
  0 ≤ b →
    {z | ↑⌊b⌋₊ < RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyActivationCount z} =
      {z | b < RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyActivationCount z}

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.familyMaskedSignMaximum_all_active_bound_real
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ (P : RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.SymmetricFamilyParameters) (n m : ℕ) [inst : NeZero m] {b : ℝ},
  0 ≤ b →
    (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyRestArrayLaw P n m).real
        {z |
          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyMaskedSignMaximum z ≠
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyActivationCount z} ≤
      (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyRestArrayLaw P n m).real
          {z | b < RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyActivationCount z} +
        Real.exp (-↑m * (P.pi / 2) ^ b)

full_type_evidence.name: RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.familyMaskedSignMaximum_mean_deficit
full_type_evidence.expanded_type:
∀ (P : RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.SymmetricFamilyParameters) (n m : ℕ) [inst : NeZero m],
  ↑n * P.theta -
